one_liner: Git hosting and collaboration platform (repos, issues, PRs, Actions CI/CD) with REST and GraphQL APIs.
access_note: Any free GitHub account can self-serve create a fine-grained or classic personal access token immediately, no approval or paid plan required.
api_breadth_note: Reference sidebar spans dozens of resource groups (Actions, Repos, Issues, PRs, Orgs, Packages, Security, Copilot, Billing, etc.) with hundreds of endpoints.
existing_mcp_note: GitHub's official MCP server (github/github-mcp-server), hosted remote server or local Docker/binary.

evidence.note: Confirms PAT/OAuth/GitHub App token auth via Authorization: Bearer header.
Official GitHub MCP server repo.

researcher_notes: GitHub now recommends fine-grained PATs or GitHub Apps over classic OAuth apps.

one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and hosting web apps, with a REST API to manage projects, deployments, domains, and env vars.
access_note: Free Hobby-plan accounts can self-serve create an access token from Account Settings, or via the API/CLI, no sales contact needed.
api_breadth_note: REST API reference covers deployments, projects, domains, DNS, env vars, edge config, webhooks, teams, and authentication endpoints.
existing_mcp_note: Vercel MCP, official hosted OAuth-based remote MCP server, supports Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex CLI, and more.

evidence.note: REST API reference confirming Bearer-token auth.
Confirms official MCP server, OAuth flow, and supported AI clients.

researcher_notes: Vercel MCP restricts connections to a Vercel-approved allowlist of AI clients, a mild constraint vs the underlying REST API.

one_liner: Platform for building, deploying, and hosting web apps/sites, with a REST API for sites, deploys, forms, env vars, and DNS.
access_note: Free Netlify accounts can self-serve generate a personal access token from Applications settings with no approval step.
api_breadth_note: Covers sites, deploys, env vars, forms, snippets, hooks/webhooks, and functions.
existing_mcp_note: Netlify's official MCP server, hosted remote endpoint, launched June 2025.

evidence.note: Confirms OAuth2/Bearer PAT auth, base URL, rate limits, full endpoint catalog.
Official Netlify MCP server repo.

researcher_notes: Confirmed Netlify has an official, actively maintained MCP server as of mid-2026.

one_liner: CDN/edge network, security, and serverless (Workers, R2, DNS, Zero Trust) platform with a very large REST API.
access_note: Free Cloudflare accounts can self-serve create scoped API tokens (or legacy Global API keys) from the dashboard with no sales approval.
api_breadth_note: Over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust and every other product.
existing_mcp_note: Cloudflare runs many official managed remote MCP servers, including a full-API MCP server plus 15+ product-specific servers.

evidence.note: Confirms API token as the preferred auth method, with legacy Global API key as fallback.
Lists the official Cloudflare API MCP server and 15 product-specific official MCP servers.

researcher_notes: Cloudflare's flagship MCP server uses a novel 'search+execute Code Mode' pattern to make the enormous API surface usable by LLM agents.

one_liner: Open-source Firebase alternative (Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions) with a Management API to control projects and org infrastructure.
access_note: Free-tier Supabase accounts can self-serve generate personal access tokens from the account dashboard; Management API works on all plans.
api_breadth_note: Covers projects, organizations, database, auth/SSO, storage, edge functions, branching, secrets, domains, and billing.
existing_mcp_note: Official Supabase MCP server (32 tools), listed as an official Claude connector, works on all Supabase plans.

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer-token auth (PAT or OAuth2), rate limits, and full endpoint category list.
Confirms official MCP server status and Claude connector listing.

researcher_notes: Management API controls project/org infrastructure, not row-level data — data access uses separate project-level API keys/JWTs.

one_liner: Graph database; Aura is the managed cloud offering with an Aura API for instance/tenant management plus a separate Cypher Query API for data access.
access_note: Neo4j Aura Free tier requires no credit card and lets any account self-serve create Aura API client credentials immediately from the console.
api_breadth_note: The Aura API mainly covers instance/tenant lifecycle; actual graph querying goes through a separate Cypher Query API or Bolt driver.
existing_mcp_note: Official Neo4j MCP server, works with Aura, self-managed, Docker, and Desktop deployments.

evidence.note: Confirms Aura API base URL and OAuth2 bearer-token auth for instance management.
Confirms client ID/secret credential creation flow.

researcher_notes: Neo4j splits functionality across two different APIs with two different auth schemes, adding integration complexity.

one_liner: Cloud data warehouse / AI Data Cloud with SQL and Cortex REST APIs for querying, loading data, and running LLM-powered functions.
access_note: Snowflake offers a self-serve 30-day free trial with $400 in credits and no credit card, during which key-pair or OAuth REST API credentials can be generated directly.
api_breadth_note: Spans the SQL API, unstructured-data REST API, Cortex REST API (LLM/AI functions), and object management endpoints.
existing_mcp_note: Snowflake-managed MCP server (GA Nov 2025) exposing Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents; open-source version also available.

evidence.note: Confirms key-pair (JWT) and OAuth authentication methods.
Confirms GA of Snowflake-managed MCP server.

researcher_notes: Trial account is suspended (not deleted) after 30 days/credit exhaustion — self-serve access is time-limited, not permanently free.

one_liner: Managed MongoDB cloud database service with an Atlas Administration API to manage clusters, database users, projects, and orgs.
access_note: Free Atlas accounts with the M0 free-tier cluster can self-serve create a public/private API key pair from Project Access Manager, no approval needed.
api_breadth_note: Atlas Administration API covers clusters, projects, orgs, database users, network access, billing, alerts, and backups.
existing_mcp_note: Official MongoDB MCP Server supports both database operations and Atlas administration; also offered as an Atlas-managed hosted MCP option.

evidence.note: Confirms API keys use HTTP Digest auth, plus newer OAuth2 service accounts.
Confirms official MongoDB MCP server and its Atlas + local deployment options.

researcher_notes: Atlas API keys use HTTP Digest authentication rather than a simple Bearer token, slightly more work for a toolkit to implement.

one_liner: Observability platform (metrics, logs, APM, dashboards, monitors) with a broad REST API covering nearly every product surface.
access_note: Datadog offers a self-serve 14-day free trial requiring no payment card, during which a user can generate their own API and application keys.
api_breadth_note: API reference spans metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents, security signals, APM, and service accounts.
existing_mcp_note: Official Datadog MCP Server, hosted/remote, also distributed via the Anthropic plugin marketplace.

evidence.note: Confirms DD-API-KEY and DD-APPLICATION-KEY header-based key auth.
Official Datadog MCP server docs.

researcher_notes: After the 14-day trial, continued API use requires converting to a paid plan.

one_liner: Application error-tracking and performance-monitoring platform with a REST API for issues, events, projects, and releases.
access_note: Sentry's free Developer plan lets any account self-serve create user auth tokens or internal integration tokens from account settings, no approval needed.
api_breadth_note: Covers issues, events, projects, organizations, releases, and alerts — more focused than platforms like GitHub, Cloudflare, or Datadog.

evidence.note: Confirms Bearer token auth via Authorization header.
Official hosted MCP server landing page.

researcher_notes: Sentry explicitly designed its MCP server for human-in-the-loop coding-agent debugging workflows rather than fully autonomous automation.
